author: 1v1Me_
body: Well, I miss the server. Now that summer started I am just board out of my mind. A long time ago you banned me and my brothers main account Kdefender03. He did nothing wrong. It was all me. He doesn't even know what hacking is probably. Pls Im not asking you to unban me, Unban him.

title: 1v1Me_ Ban Appeal

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

Your account, 1v1Me_, ban evaded the account WackaFlackaFlame which was banned for excessive infractions (https://avicus.net/WackaFlackaFlame#infractions), the account Kdefender03 also ban evaded WackaFlackaFlame, hence why it's permanently banned. I don't care if you went on your brothers account to play on Avicus when your other account was banned, it's still evading a ban, which is why I'm denying this appeal.

Regards,
Blizzem_
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
